author: reek
body: The pin for the cross-lane port refusal. The x86 port builtins and the codex-vm GPU behind gpu-in and gpu-out have no counterpart on the ARM64 and RISC-V Renode boards, so those plugs refuse the compile with one [UNSUPPORTED] report per call, by design, instead of emitting a silently broken call. The .cross-refusal sidecar makes the cross battery demand that refusal: on a cross lane this test must FAIL to compile, naming both builtins, and on x86-64 it must compile and run normally, because there the ports are real. A refusal nobody tests is a guard nobody wired; this is the wire.
